simple.meaning: חָזַק (châzaq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to fasten upon; hence, to seize , be strong (figuratively, courageous , causatively strengthen , cure , help , repair , fortify ), obstinate ; to bind , restrain , conquer.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 290 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 6 more, beginning at Genesis 19:16. Its contexts include family line, city, land, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָזַק (H2388).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָזַק (châzaq) / H2388 is traced through Genesis 19:16, Genesis 21:18, Genesis 41:56, Genesis 41:57 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H2388. chazaq חָזַק 291 verb be or grow firm, strong, strengthen (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic חֲזַק bind on or about, gird on , compare Arabic bind, squeeze ) — Qal Perfect ׳ח Gen 41:57 4 t.; חָזָק֑ 2Chr 26:15 ; suffix חֲזָקוֺ 28:20 , etc.; Imperfect יֶהֱז֑ק 28:7 (Baer) + 2 t.; וַיֶּחֱזַק Gen 41:56 +; יֶחֶזְקוּ 2Sam 10:11 2 t.; יֶחְזְקוּ Isa 28:22 ; Imperative חֲזַק Deut 12:23 +; חִזְקוּ 31:6 +; Infinitive construct לְחָזְקָה 2Kin 12:13 ; suffix לְחָזְקָהּ Ezek 30:21 ; Participle חָזֵק Exod 19:19 ; 2Sam 3:1 , etc.; — I. intransitive be or grow strong: — 1. a. of physical strength of hands Judg 7:11 ; 2Sam 2:7 ; 16:21 ; Ezek 22:14 ; Zech 8:9 , 13 (on Ezek 3:14 see below); of arm, followed by infinitive 30:21 ; used of recovery from illness Isa 39:1 ; followed by מִן of comparison over power 1Sam 17:50 (with בְּ instrumental), 2Sam 13:14 . b. of people, army Deut 11:8 ; Josh 17:13 (JE), = Judg 1:28 ; Ezra 9:12 ; followed by מִן comparative be stronger than, too strong for, prevail against 2Sam 10:11 (twice in verse) = 1Chr 19:12 (twice in verse); 1Kin 20:23 , 25 ; id. , followed by accusative 16:22 , compare of ׳י as prevailing over man Jer 20:7 (|| יָכֹל ); followed by על 2Chr 8:3 ; 27:5 . c. of royal power וְהָזֵק הֹלֵךְ וְדָוִד 2Sam 3:1 (opposed to וְדַלִּים הֹלְכִים ); compare 2Chr 26:15 (|| חֶזְקָה 26:16 ), Dan 11:5 a. d. prevail over, upon , of word of king 2Sam 24:4 (followed by אֶלֿ ) = 1Chr 21:4 (followed by עַל ). e. of bonds Isa 28:22 . f. of sound of trumpet מְאֹד וְהָזֵק הוֺלֵךְ Exod 19:19 (E, compare חָזָק 19:16 ) it grew much louder and louder. 2 be firm, fast: — a. literally be caught fast , of Absalom's head 2Sam 18:9 (followed by בְּ ). b. be firm, secure , of a kingdom 2Kin 14:5 ( + בְּיָדוֺ ) = 2Chr 25:3 ( + עָלָיו ). But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.

Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why don’t you repair the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”
The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.

But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into Yahweh’s house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house into it.
But there were not made for Yahweh’s house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house;
Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.
